changed.what: All 10 revalidateTag calls (nine key helpers plus the per-photo tag in revalidatePhoto) now pass a shared REVALIDATE_PROFILE = { expire: 0 } as the second argument.

decisions: I used { expire: 0 } (immediate expiration). Next 15's single-argument revalidateTag expired the tag immediately, so this keeps behaviour the same, and it is valid in Server Actions, Route Handlers and other contexts.
I did not use "max" (stale-while-revalidate). It would change freshness: admin edits could show stale data on the next request.
I did not use updateTag. It only works in Server Actions, and these helpers may also be called from Route Handlers.
I defined one constant so the freshness policy can be changed in one place.

I made no changes for the repo-owner items (webpack/Turbopack, images config, middleware to proxy, the build/analyze/lint scripts, Node and TypeScript versions). They are outside the files I may edit.
assumptions: The previous behaviour (immediate expiry of tagged cache entries) is what the owner wants kept. The pack says to ask about the intended freshness; I couldn't ask, so I chose the behaviour-preserving option and am flagging it for confirmation.
Callers outside this file, which I can't edit, may run in Server Actions. If so, they could switch to updateTag for read-your-writes, but I have not checked them.
couldNotDo: I could not confirm the freshness semantics with the repo owner. Please confirm that { expire: 0 } is intended, or whether "max" or updateTag fits particular call sites.
I did not review the other Next 16 upgrade items (config, scripts, middleware, version checks), since they are outside my editable files.
No tests are related to src/photo/cache.ts, so none ran. Type check and lint pass.

decisions: - `next.config.ts` has `webpack`: next dev/build now default to Turbopack; keep --webpack or migrate the custom webpack configuration.
- `next.config.ts` has `images`: review image defaults (TTL 14400s, sizes omit 16, qualities [75], at most 3 redirects and blocked local IPs) and localPatterns.search; preserve image security.
- `middleware.ts` uses the middleware convention: proxy is Node-only; retain middleware if Edge is required and review the runtime before renaming.

- `package.json` scripts.build invokes next build; `package.json` scripts.analyze invokes next build: next lint is removed and next build no longer lints; use an explicit ESLint command and CI lint gate.
- No Node version found in the inventoried package.json, runtime pins or CI; verify Node >=20.9.0
- Also review the [Next 16 upgrade guide](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/upgrading/version-16) for metadata promises, browser support and target-minor changes.
